description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the CFD Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Water Purification Reactor [CFD Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the CFD Module (Single-Phase Flow): Water Purification Reactor. Physics interfaces: Turbulent Flow, k-epsilon (spf). Study steps: Stationary. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("CFD_Module/Single-Phase_Flow/water_purification_reactor") to solve it, comsol_example_info("water_purification_reactor", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > CFD Module > Single-Phase Flow > water purification reactor

parameters.name: spf
parameters.description: physics interface Turbulent Flow, k-epsilon (API type TurbulentFlowkeps)

tools.notes: Library path CFD_Module/Single-Phase_Flow/water_purification_reactor; model file 8.6 MB. Documented Java build script available (rebuild with comsol_run_example method='java'). Requires the module licence to open and solve.
